fusions.name: Lowered Tines
fusions.desc: You level the forked head of the staff and rush a target up to 6 tiles away. It deals 12 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sudden Crack
fusions.desc: Cracks the staff on the ground. It deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 25% chance to be startled into turning on its neighbours for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stot Over
fusions.desc: You vault 4 tiles forward on the staff, then move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Guard Already Up
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a dodge that fails is rolled again as a parry with the staff, and the second roll stands.
